actions.script: if (!ec.search.isAvailable()) { ec.message.addMessage(ec.l10n.localize("Search is not configured, not updating mappings"), "danger"); return; } ec.search.ensureIndex({indexName: indexName});

service.description: Index all documents associated with the feed within the date range. Recommend calling through the IndexDataFeedDocuments service job.

The queryString format is the Lucene-style subset SearchFacade parses: terms with a trailing * for prefix or *term* for contains, field:value, _exists_:field, *:*, field:[a TO b], quoted phrases, AND, OR, NOT, +, -, and parentheses. A dotted field (roles.roleTypeId) matches when any element of that child list has the value.
nestedQueryMap keys are child list paths (or empty for a top-level clause); each value is a query that one element must satisfy: an Elastic-style bool/term/terms/match/range/exists map or JSON string, or a SearchFacade query map. query is an optional SearchFacade query map that must also match. filter is an optional SearchFacade query map that limits what may match at all, such as an organization limit. It does not score and it applies before totals and highlights.
orderByFields entries are field names with an optional leading + or -; a trailing .keyword names the unanalyzed value.

parameter.name: documentType
parameter.description: The DataDocument ID, or a comma-separated list of them; when empty every document in indexName is searched.

parameter.name: nestedQueryMap
parameter.description: For explicit field constraints and such; key is path and may be null for a general query; value is a query JSON String (parsed to Map) or a query Map object

parameter.name: query
parameter.description: A SearchFacade query map, AND-ed with the queryString.

parameter.name: filter
parameter.description: A SearchFacade query map that limits the documents searched, not scored.

parameter.name: documentListCount
parameter.description: The total count of hits, not just the limited number returned.

parameter.name: dataDocumentId
parameter.description: For DataFeed compatibility; when specified the document is deleted from this DataDocument (or comma-separated list) instead of every DataDocument in indexName

parameter.name: timestampField
parameter.description: @timestamp and _timestamp are the time each document was indexed; any other name is a date field of the documents.

service.description: Embed documents that have no current embedding, for semantic and hybrid search. Does nothing unless search-facade/semantic is enabled, pgvector is installed, and an embedder is installed.
Drop the search store of every DataDocument in indexName. The next index call makes it again.

actions.script: if (!ec.search.isAvailable()) { ec.message.addMessage(ec.l10n.localize("Search is not configured, not dropping an index"), "danger"); return; } ec.search.dropIndex({indexName: indexName});
